js: (async()=>{const A=__CITY_APP,s=A.scene;const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const meas=async()=>{await sleep(1500);let n=0;const t=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){n++;if(performance.now()-t<3000)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});return ((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(1)};const out=[];out.push('base '+await meas());const T=s.getObjectByName('Trees').children;const mid=T.filter(m=>/_mid$/.test(m.name));mid.forEach(m=>m.castShadow=false);out.push('midShadow off '+await meas());mid.forEach(m=>m.castShadow=true);const G=s.getObjectByName('CityGround');const gc=[];G.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&o.castShadow){gc.push(o)}});out.push('ground casters: '+gc.map(o=>o.name).join(','));gc.forEach(o=>o.castShadow=false);out.push('groundShadow off '+await meas());gc.forEach(o=>o.castShadow=true);const D=s.getObjectByName('CityStreetDetails');const dc=[];D.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&o.castShadow)dc.push(o)});dc.forEach(o=>o.castShadow=false);out.push('detailsShadow off ('+dc.length+') '+await meas());dc.forEach(o=>o.castShadow=true);out.push('base again '+await meas());console.log('[ablate2] '+out.join(' | '))})()
